weather.name: 和风天气
paragraphs: 天气仅显示当前接口实际返回的小时。超出覆盖的时段显示暂无数据，天文计算与计划仍可使用。
总云量不代表低云、中云或高云；能见度不能代替透明度与视宁度。
weather.precision: 逐小时预报；仅保留当前响应实际返回的时段

terrain.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
paragraphs: © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
Starward resampled the WGS84 DSM onto a GCJ-02 grid, then derived hillshade, elevation colour and transparent no-data pixels.
2021 年源数据；当前发布覆盖大湾区局部，派生网格约 110.7 米。覆盖外与缺测分别保留，不用于地平线遮挡角计算。
terrain.validity: 2021 源数据；大湾区局部派生版本 v2
terrain.precision: 源约30米；派生网格110.7米，GCJ-02。非地平线遮挡角。

nightlight.name: EOG Annual VNL V2.2
nightlight.credit: Source: EOG, Colorado School of Mines.
paragraphs: This product was made utilizing Annual VNL V2.2 data produced by the Earth Observation Group, Payne Institute for Public Policy, Colorado School of Mines.

Starward selected the declared AOI, masked insufficient cloud-free coverage and invalid radiance, aggregated valid pixels into relative night-light bands, and sampled spot neighbourhoods; displayed map bounds are converted to GCJ-02.
年度卫星向上辐亮度估算，不是实时天空亮度、Bortle 等级或现场 SQM 测量。

engine.name: Astronomy Engine
paragraphs: 按地点与所选时刻计算天体位置；理论地平线上方不代表现场一定可见，山体、建筑与云层可能遮挡。

star.name: HEASARC · BSC5P
paragraphs: Hoffleit & Warren (1991), Bright Star Catalog, 5th Revised Edition (Preliminary Version); HEASARC, NASA/GSFC
Starward 筛选亮星、转换坐标并统一标识。星名来源另遵循 IAU WGSN；不使用 Hipparcos 数值天体测量。
star.precision: J2000 目录位置及自行；字段缺失不补零。

deep.name: AllWISE W3 · IRSA / CDS
deep.license: HiPS 数据库 ODbL 1.0；影像 IPAC/NASA
paragraphs: This publication makes use of data products from the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer, which is a joint project of the University of California, Los Angeles, and the Jet Propulsion Laboratory/California Institute of Technology, and NEOWISE, which is a project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory/California Institute of Technology. WISE and NEOWISE are funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

Contains information from AllWISE W3 HiPS (CDS/Aladin; CNRS/Unistra), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL). Starward offers its imagery selection and arrangement under ODbL; individual AllWISE images retain their separate WISE/NEOWISE acknowledgment and IPAC/NASA rights.

Starward selected 51 Messier galaxy/nebula targets and published three north-up ICRS TAN JPEG cutouts per target through CDS hips2fits, with 1-99.7 percentile asinh grayscale stretch; these are processed 12 micrometer survey images, not visible-light photographs.
Historical 12 micrometer survey imagery; it is neither naked-eye appearance nor realtime sky data.
Source-survey saturation and detector artifacts may remain after bounded stretch and resampling.
IRSA DOI: 10.26131/IRSA153
CDS/Aladin — CNRS/Unistra · DOI: 10.26093/cds/aladin/na1n-03
deep.validity: 历史 AllWISE W3 12μm 巡天
deep.precision: ICRS TAN 北向上裁片；三档视野，不是可见光或实时影像。

opengc.name: OpenNGC · Mattia Verga and contributors
paragraphs: Starward 从指定 OpenNGC 版本筛选 51 个带 Messier 标识的星系／星云，统一类型和名称字段，将赤经／赤纬转换为十进制度并重排为 JSON；派生目录继续按 CC BY-SA 4.0 提供。

Target identities and coordinates are adapted from OpenNGC v20260501, Mattia Verga and contributors, under CC BY-SA 4.0. Starward selected Messier galaxies/nebulae and converted coordinates to decimal degrees; these catalog fields remain CC BY-SA 4.0, separately from the imagery database.
opengc.precision: 目录坐标，ICRS；坐标转为十进制度。

meteor.name: Global Meteor Network
paragraphs: Global Meteor Network，2022—2023 历史轨迹与活动参考；Starward 做一度分箱中位数及太阳中心黄道坐标线性漂移拟合。
年度日期为太阳黄经参考映射，不代表今年精确极大、活动曲线或爆发预报。

recent.name: 和风天气 · 近期天气
paragraphs: 邻近地区前两个自然日的历史再分析，不含今天；不是点位过去48小时现场实测。未返回字段不补齐。
recent.validity: 以本条地区记录或小时为准
recent.precision: 邻近地区前两个自然日的历史再分析，不含今天；不是点位过去48小时现场实测。未返回字段不补齐。

air.name: 和风天气 · 空气质量
paragraphs: 区域当前空气质量与所选小时预报分别展示；不同AQI标准保留原值。
air.validity: 以本条地区记录或小时为准
air.precision: 区域当前空气质量与所选小时预报分别展示；不同AQI标准保留原值。

warning.validity: 以本条地区记录或小时为准
warning.precision: 预警保留当前数据的原发布机构、发布时间、生效与到期时刻及指令，失败不能推断没有预警。

vega.name: NASA Night Sky Network · 织女星介绍
vega.license: NASA 内容使用指引；具体第三方素材权利另行适用
paragraphs: 介绍资料与天体位置计算分别标注来源。

editorial.name: Starward · 观测前的准备
paragraphs: 文章资料独立于天文目录，不修改事件数值。

eclipse.name: Astronomy Engine · 日月食计算
eclipse.precision: 食甚与食相由 miniapp-event-projection@2.0.0+astronomy-engine@2.1.19 按 UTC 计算；目录日期采用北京时间，所在地时刻单独换算并显示到分钟
paragraphs: 全球食事件目录是锁定算法的计算结果，不是实时观测公告
地点可见性必须另行结合观察者坐标、太阳或月球高度计算
天气和真实地平遮挡不属于该算法目录
